''See also: [[Othaghor Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Othaghor is a [[Great Elder]] known as the [[Hordefather]], characterized by a profound vanity and pride. Unlike other [[Elders]] who pursue cosmic [[destruction]] or knowledge, Othaghor's primary drive is the preservation of life. He possesses an unparalleled understanding of biological mechanics, though he views humanity with indifference, seeing them as no more significant than common insects or amphibians. Physically, the Elder is described as having a gorilla-like build with leathery olive skin and a head resembling a bullfrog, complete with bulging yellow eyes and a wide, toothy mouth. Othaghor commands vast, diverse armies of creatures that behave more like animals than sentient beings, driven by instinct to feed and reproduce rather than by complex logic. These include amphibious hordes, many-legged beasts, and various bizarre creatures. His influence is felt through his followers and the specialized spawn he creates, such as the [[Bellowing Horror]]. Historically, Othaghor's domain was a site of constant warfare against the territory of [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion|Tharlos]]. His presence is also marked by desert temples and massive [[stone]] obelisks excavated by human slaves. While he has been buried in the past, his power remains a significant force that can be felt through his various minions and biological creations.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Originally, the [[Greenwardens]] were established to counteract the worship of Othaghor. This entity is known for its ability to share bodies and contains a desert temple within itself. During the journey of the [[Estyr Six]], they eventually reached Othaghor. While [[Calder]] successfully conquered his brood and unnamed monsters, the entity's primary desire is to preserve life above all else.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Othaghor is an unknown entity characterized by endless biology involving constant mutation, consumption, and breeding. This creature possesses a flattened, centipede-like body the size of a large dog, featuring bright green skin, webbed amphibian legs, and three yellow eyes on each side of its head. Its anatomy includes jaws resembling a cross between spider mandibles and fish teeth, as well as a long [[stinger]] with a red tip at the end of its body. As a being capable of creating any living creature, Othaghor is the creator of [[Elderspawn]] and maintains spawn that inhabit the island. The resulting hordes are known for their variety of poisons and possess claws capable of piercing minds and rending [[Iron|iron]].}}
